name: ASTRAGALUS MOLLISSIMUS
key_symptoms: Weakness and emptiness. Burning in śsophagus and stomach.
Fullness in right temple and upper jaw. Pain over left eyebrow. Painful facial bones. Dizzy. Pressive pain in temples. Pain and pressure in maxillć.
Purring sensation in right foot outer side from heel to toe. Icy coldness of left calf.
